title: Insured Plan of Care Extensions: How Long the Coming Authorization Period Runs
content:
**Training note — Insured Plan of Care.** How long the period an extension request covers runs depends on the Appointment Series the plan funds:

- where the plan has a **booked** series, the period runs through that series' end date;
- where it has no booked series but an **active** one, through the active series' end date;
- otherwise the period lasts as many days as the current authorization covers.

The days of the period are counted from its first day through its last, both included, and are never fewer than zero.

## Questions and answers (hypothetical)

**The period starts 2026-05-21 and the plan's booked series ends 2026-06-30. How many days?** 41 (2026-05-21 through 2026-06-30).

**The period starts today, 2026-05-05; there is no booked series and the active series ends 2026-06-15. How many days?** 42.

**No booked or active series; the current authorization covered 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-12. How many days?** 42, the days that authorization covers.

**The period would start 2026-05-21 but the active series ends 2026-05-15. How many days?** None — the end falls before the start, so the count is zero.
